description_en: Retrieves the details of a ticket task for regular data changes, lock-free changes, or data imports
description_zh: 获取普通数据变更、无锁变更、数据导入工单任务详情
name: GetDataCorrectTaskDetail

parameters.help_en: The ticket ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/208388.html, https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/208387.html, or https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/208386.html operation to obtain this parameter
parameters.help_zh: 工单号，您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/208388.html、https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/208387.html、https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/208386.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: order_id

parameters.help_en:
The tenant ID.
You can obtain the tenant ID by moving the pointer over the profile picture in the upper-right corner of the console. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/181330.html
parameters.help_zh:
租户ID。
取自系统右上角头像处悬停展示的租户ID信息，详情请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/181330.html
parameters.name: tid

DataCorrectTaskDetail.description_en: The execution details of the change task

CreateTime.description_en: The time when the task was created

DBTaskGroupId.description_en: The ID of the SQL task group

jobStatus.description_en:
The status of the SQL task. Valid values:
INIT: The task is initialized.
PENDING: The task is waiting to be fetched.
BE_SCHEDULED: The task is waiting to be scheduled.
FAIL: The task failed.
SUCCESS: The task succeeded.
PAUSE: The task is paused.
DELETE: The task is deleted.
RUNNING: The task is running
jobStatus.description_zh:
SQL详情状态，取值：
INIT：初始化状态
PENDING：等待任务抓取
BE_SCHEDULED：待调度
FAIL：执行失败
SUCCESS：执行成功
PAUSE：暂停
DELETE：删除
RUNNING：正在执行

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request was successful
